cues: A person who wants everything is always off balance, because there is always something more to want.
Limits give a fixed centre to live from.
In plain words: a man who knows what is expected of him, and what is closed to him, is calmer than a man who is free to want anything.
text: Equilibrium means balance. A person who wants everything is always off balance, because there is always something more to want. Limits give a fixed centre to live from. In plain words: a man who knows what is expected of him, and what is closed to him, is calmer than a man who is free to want anything.
